- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Confirmed. The chain is complete — avatar bytes are stored inline as a data URI in the `user.avatar_url` column, read via the user store, not from a separate file/blob store.

h07.
`(*FileServerService).serveUserAvatar` — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168
`(*FileServerService).getUserByUsername` — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715
`(*Store).GetUser` — store/user.go:148
`(*Store).ListUsers` — store/user.go:136
`(*DB).ListUsers` (SQLite driver; runs `SELECT ... avatar_url ... FROM user`) — store/db/sqlite/user.go:88

Notes:
- Route registration: `GET /file/users/:identifier/avatar` at server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:124.
- The image bytes are not a separate file/attachment; they live inline in the user's `avatar_url` column as a base64 data URI, decoded by `(*FileServerService).parseDataURI` (server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:737) before being written to the response.
- `(*Store).GetUser`/`ListUsers` populate `userCache`, so a warm cache can short-circuit the DB hop. The equivalent driver methods for other backends are store/db/postgres/user.go:87 and store/db/mysql/user.go:84.
